entities.summary: Flavianos Michael Malke, born Ya'Qūb Melkī; was an Eastern Catholic prelate of the Brothers of Saint Ephrem of a Syriac background. He became the Syrian Catholic eparch of Gazarta. Malke was killed in Gazarta during the Assyrian genocide after he refused to convert to Islam.
